name: Replacement b3 — figure-sequences, 1 low item

currentCoverage.note: unchanged from the b2 plan; this batch replaces one retired item and does not shift coverage

overrepresented: symbol count as a proxy for difficulty
border travel (34 of 93 symbol-rules in the pre-retirement bank)
gaps: replacement for the item retired after the Phase 5 pilot quality review

allowed: linear and diagonal movement at 1 field, bounce-as-reversal
border travel cw/ccw at 1, 2 or x+1 fields
colour cycles of 2 or 3 colours, all visible in the shown matrices
review: rotation on shapes beyond triangle and arrow
forbidden: billiard reflection as the correct boundary behaviour
linear or diagonal movement above one field per step other than x+1, including in distractors
figures disappearing, overlapping or leaving the matrix
shown matrices admitting more than one legal continuation
a colour cycle containing a colour never shown

difficultyModel.metric: peak transformation load, measured after simulation, never inherited from the plan
difficultyModel.high: 3-4 symbols, peakLoad >= 4; x+1 optional, targeted at roughly half

distractorConstraints.fallback: position, only when no rule-based error is available

structuralConstraints.fingerprint: tier | per-symbol (movement family, step class, rotation, colour-cycle length, symmetry-canonical track)
structuralConstraints.note: fingerprint cap counts the existing bank; family cap is a within-batch spread heuristic

seedStrategy: seed = SHA-256(generator, section, tier, batchId, index, attempt); one independent stream per slot, so batch size cannot perturb earlier slots

expectedDistribution.low: 1 item, replacing the retired low-tier item
